goal: A world simulation engine where LLM agents debate and interact to explore counterfactual hypotheses and population dynamics — implement open issues, improve the simulation (make it better/faster), and improve the visualizations.
guards: Do not delete or overwrite existing tests
Do not modify files outside the declared scope
Do not introduce secrets or credentials into the repository
Do not modify CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or pyproject.toml structure
constraints: Prefer small, incremental changes over large rewrites
Each change should be accompanied by at least one test
Follow the existing code style and conventions
Work on one feature at a time
Keep changes within the selected feature scope

project_eval.name: test_suite
project_eval.description: Run the full pytest test suite

eval_spec: Run the CLI with --help and verify it prints usage information
Run the CLI with a sample input and verify it produces expected output
